hook: 先 means ahead or before, as in 先生 and 先月: the one that came first.
From 作る (to make): how something is made, its build or structure.
来 means come: きたる is a formal "coming", as in "the coming Sunday".
強 means strong, as in 強い; きょう is its sound in words like 勉強.
Self (自) + turn (転): the Earth turning by itself, its spin. Same start as 自転車.
From 調べる (to check): a check or investigation.
決 means decide, as in 決める: a decision or a vote.
From 覚える (to remember): what you remember, your memory or experience.
実 means fruit or real: the real result, as in 実は (actually).
Cold (冷) + storehouse (蔵): keeping things cold, as in 冷蔵庫 (fridge).
From 助ける (to help): help, as in shouting 助けて! (help me!).
頭 means head: かしら is an old word for the head person, the chief.
美 means beauty, as in 美しい: a big (大) sheep (羊) was beautiful to ancient people.
公 means public, as in 公園 (park): things that belong to everyone.
天 means heaven or sky, as in 天気 (weather: the mood of the sky).
Water (氵) + origin (原): where the water starts, the source.
主 means master or owner: the old lord of a place, like the big fish that rules a pond.
主 means main or master, as in 主人 (master, husband) and 主語 (subject).
Most (最) + middle (中): right in the very middle of something.
Shell (貝, old money) on the left: money and riches, as in 財布 (wallet).
Person (亻) + straight (直): what an honest person says a thing is worth, its value.
Person (人) + air (気): the feeling that people are around. Not にんき (popular)!
蔵 means storehouse: a くら is an old Japanese warehouse, like a sake くら.
様 means manner or look: add it to a name for a very polite Mr./Ms., like お客様.
故 means reason or old (as in 故郷): ゆえ is a formal "because".
From 慣れる (to get used to): being used to something through practice.
From 届ける (to deliver): a form you deliver to an office, a notice.
Effect (効) + rate (率): how much effect you get for your effort, efficiency.
Plant (艹) + what (何): bundles of grass to carry, a load. Think 荷物 (luggage).
丈 means length or height: たけ is how long or tall something is, like a dress.
From 上がる (to go up): rising, income coming up, or finishing.
Rule (制) + clothes (服): clothes set by the rules, a uniform.
Roof (宀) over a full jar: a house full of goods, wealth.
From 動く (to move): heavy (重) + power (力) makes things move, movement.
Teach (教) + section (科): a section of what is taught, a school subject, as in 教科書.
Now (今) + heart (心): what is in your heart right now, a thought or feeling.
Ear (耳) + heart (心): your ears go red and your heart feels it, shame.
類 means kind or type: things of the same kind, as in 種類 (types).
Work hard (勤) + duty (務): doing your work duties, your job.
Hand (扌) + branch (支): skill with your hands, a technique, like a judo move.
Original (原) + text (文): the original text before translation.
Win (勝) + hand (手): doing as you like (selfish); also the kitchen, as in お勝手.
Trunk (幹) + line (線): the main trunk line, as in 新幹線 (bullet train).
Sink (沈) + silent (黙): sinking into silence.
Beauty (美) + skill (術): the skill of making beauty, fine art, as in 美術館.
当 means this or the one in question: 当ホテル is "this hotel (ours)".
雑 means mixed or rough: things thrown together, as in 雑誌 (magazine).
Four mouths (口) around a dog (犬): many dishes, so a bowl or container.
Big (大) + house (家): a great family, or a master of an art. (おおや is a landlord.)
Protect (保) + danger (険): protection against danger, insurance.
Water (氵) + soldier (兵): soldiers landing at the water's edge, the beach.
乳 means milk or breast, as in 牛乳 (cow's milk).
Guide (導) + enter (入): guiding something in, introducing it.
From 行う (to do, carry out): what you do, your conduct.
From 恐れる (to fear): fear, or the fear that something bad may happen.
Watch over (看) + protect (護): watching over the sick, nursing, as in 看護師.
Plan (企) + draw (画): drawing up a plan, a project.
Send out (発) + words (言): putting your words out, speaking up.
Dim (幽) + spirit (霊): a faint spirit, a ghost.
Avoid (避) + trouble (難): escaping from danger, taking shelter.
画 means a stroke or picture: 5画 is a kanji with five strokes.
杯 means cup, as in 一杯 (one cupful): さかずき is a small sake cup.
角 is a picture of an animal horn; it also means corner (かど).
味 means taste: added to a word it means a touch of it, like 甘味 (sweetness).
Disaster (災) + harm (害): damage from a disaster, a calamity.
Respond (応) + recruit (募): answering a call for people, applying.
Open (開) + start (発): opening up something new, development.
Proof (証) + basis (拠): the basis that proves it, evidence.
Real (実) + house (家): your real home, where your parents live.
Beginning (始) + end (末): dealing with it from start to end, cleaning up.
Section (部) + under (下): people under you in your section, your staff.
From 招く (to invite): hand (扌) + call (召); a 招き猫 cat waves to invite luck.
封 means seal, as in 封筒 (envelope): the thing you seal.
Edge (縁) + side (側): the wooden porch along the edge of a Japanese house.
Parent (親) + father (父): your dad, or an old man.
Help between (介) + protect (護): caring for old or sick people.
Electricity (電) + source (源): where the power comes from, the power switch.
From 諦める (to give up): accepting that it is over.
弾 means bullet or bounce: はじく is to flick or bounce off. (Read ひく, it means to play.)
From 結ぶ (to tie): a knot or ending; おむすび is rice pressed together.
Bamboo (竹) + same (同): bamboo is the same shape all the way, a tube or pipe.
Two thin bent bows (弓): weak or delicate. じゃく is its sound in 弱点 (weak point).
Valley (谷) + lack (欠): an empty valley you want to fill, greed or desire.
心 means heart or mind: 好奇心 is a curious mind.
我 means self: 我慢 (がまん) is holding your self back, being patient.
我 means I or self: 我々 (われわれ) is "we".
幹 means trunk, as in 新幹線: the main trunk of a tree.
Do (行) + do (為): something you do, an act.
止 means stop: とどめる is to stop something and keep it where it is.
From 流す (to let flow): where water flows away, the kitchen sink.
One (一) + cut (切): everything in one cut, all, or with a negative "not at all".
From 写す (to copy): a copy.
Business (業) + person (者): a business person, a trader or contractor.
Carry out (施) + set up (設): something set up for people, a facility.
Body (体) + test (験): testing with your own body, personal experience.
Retreat (退) + job (職): leaving your job, retiring.
From 違う (to differ): to make different, to change.
Goods (品) + quality (質): the quality of goods.
Carry on the back (負) + carry on the shoulder (担): something you carry, a burden.
Full (満) + moon (月): a full moon.
Face (面) + eyes (目): your face before others, your honor.
Same word as めんぼく: face (面) + eyes (目), how you look to others, your honor.
Say humbly (申) + put in (込): putting your request in, an application.
Flower (花) + びら (a flat sheet): the flat pieces of a flower, petals.
From 折る (to fold): a fold in time, a chance or occasion.
Run (走) + take (取): what draws you in, the charm or feel of a place.
Grain (禾) + heavy (重): grain seeds; a kind or species, as in 種類.
縁 means edge or link: the へり is the edge or border of something.
Exchange (交) + cross water (渉): going back and forth, negotiating.
Orphan (孤) + alone (独): all alone, lonely.
From 叫ぶ (to shout): mouth (口) open wide, a scream.
Inside (内): keep it inside, a secret between us.
Change (転) + work (勤): changing your workplace, a job transfer.
Think (思) + consider (考): thinking.
True (真) + real (実): the real truth.
New (新) + person (人): a newcomer.
From 育つ (to grow up): how you were raised.
True (本) + spirit (気): your true feeling, being serious.
Main (本) + text (文): the main text of a letter or document.
Kind (優) + first (先): letting someone go first, priority, as in 優先席.
Run (走) past it: go beyond, so super or ultra, as in 超いい.
Person (亻) + temple (寺): a person who serves and waits on a lord, a samurai.
Decide (決) + cut (断): cutting off doubt and deciding firmly.
From 悩む (to worry): a troubled heart (忄), a worry.
Receive (受け) + put in (入れ): taking something in, accepting it.
芸 means art or skill, as in 芸術 (art) and 芸能人 (entertainer).
Do (仕) + put together (組): how parts are put together, a mechanism.
Market (市) + place (場): the market as an idea. (いちば is a real market place.)
From 当てる (to hit): a target you aim for, something you count on.
Later (後) + turn (回し): turning it to later, putting it off.
Entrust (委) + leave with (託): leaving a job in someone's hands.
Rise (昇) + advance (進): moving up at work, a promotion.
Examine (診) + heal (療): a doctor checking and treating you.
From 進む (to move forward): progress.
Become (成) + fruit (果): what your work becomes, the results.
Before (前) + hold up (提): what is put forward first, a premise.
Face (対) + respond (応): facing something and responding, dealing with it.
Embankment (堤) + defend (防): a bank that defends against the river.
Tired (疲) + labor (労): tiredness from work, fatigue.
Tree (木) on the left: a wooden tag; also paper money, as in お札.
Violent (暴) + power (力): violence.
Use (用) + paper (紙): paper for a use, a form.
要 means need or main point: to need, to require.
避 means avoid: よける is to step aside and dodge something.
From 汚れる (to get dirty): dirty water (氵), dirt or a stain.
From 果てる (to end): the very end, the far edge.
光 means light, as in 日光 (sunlight) and 観光 (sightseeing).
Plant (艹) + enjoy (楽): plants that make you feel good, medicine, as in 胃腸薬.
Present (現) + ground (地): the actual place where it happens, local.
Match (合) + mind (意): minds that match, agreement.
察 means observe: to read the situation and guess what someone feels.
Mixed (雑) + talk (談): talk about this and that, chatting.
Thing (事) + business (業): a business or big project.
Decide (決) + calculate (算): the final calculation of the accounts.
Decide (決) + win (勝): the match that decides the winner, the final.
Put up (登) + record (録): putting your name on the record, registering.
Take (取り) + replace (替え): taking one out and putting another in, a swap.
Back (背) + behind (後): right behind your back.
Abolish (廃) + stop (止): stopping something for good.
One (一) + breath (気): all in one breath, in one go.
Earth (土) + village (里): covering with earth, to bury.
From 訴える (to sue, to complain): words (言) taken to court, a complaint.
Plum (梅) + dried (干し): a dried pickled plum.
及 means reach: a hand catching the person ahead, to reach or extend.
Meet (会) + see (見): meeting people to be seen, a press conference.
Stubborn (頑) + hard (固): hard headed, stubborn.
Technique (技) + ability (能): technical skill.
Business (業) + duty (務): work duties.
Same (同) + grade (級): the same class, as in 同級生 (classmate).
Way (道) + place (場): a place to learn the way, a dojo.
From 争う (to fight over): a fight or dispute.
Say (言い) + reason (訳): saying your reasons, an excuse.
Job (職) + member (員): a staff member.
New (新) + marriage (婚): newly married.
Judge (審) + investigate (査): judging and checking, an examination.
Blow (吹) + play music (奏): playing by blowing, wind instruments, as in 吹奏楽.
Explain (説) + gain (得): explaining until you win them over, persuasion.
Only (専) + use (用): for one use or person only, exclusive.
Send (送) + money (金): sending money.
Plain (素) + simple (朴): plain and simple.
Body (体) + power (力): physical strength.
Fixed (定) + meal (食): a fixed set meal.
Point (指) + pick (摘): picking out a problem and pointing to it.
Take (取) + material (材): gathering material for a story.
Main (主) + person (人) + lord (公): the lord of the story, the main character.
Go to (赴) + duty (任): going to a new post.
Writing (文) + write (書): written papers, a document.
Repay (償): paying back for something you broke or lost.
Root (本) + nature (質): the root nature of something, its essence.
Show (見せ) + thing (物): a thing to show, a show or spectacle.
See (見) + pile up (積もり): looking and adding up the costs, an estimate.
Duty (役) + place (場): the place where officials work, the town hall.
Side (横) + rope (綱): the thick rope worn around the waist of the sumo grand champion.
Finish (了) + understand (解): fully understood, roger that.
Person (亻) on the left: a rough, manly word for "I".
故 means late or old: 故山田さん is the late Mr. Yamada.
Samurai (士) + heart (心): a samurai's heart set on a goal, ambition.
Hand (手) at the bottom: the palm of your hand.
Grass (艹) on top: short grass, a lawn, as in 芝生.
Go (行) around it: streets, a town area, as in 商店街 (shopping street).
